text: Apollo.io is a private, venture-capital-backed sales-technology company headquartered in San Francisco. Its last announced round, a $100M Series D in August 2023, was led by Bain Capital Ventures with participation from Sequoia Capital, Tribe Capital and Nexus Venture Partners; no state or state-fund investor is named.
short: Apollo.io: private, VC-backed (Bain Capital Ventures, Sequoia, Tribe, Nexus).

source.name: Apollo.io Magazine – 'Apollo.io Secures $100 Million Series D at $1.6B Valuation to Drive World-Class GTM'
source.quote: raised $100M in Series D funding led by Bain Capital Ventures (BCV), with participation from existing investors Sequoia Capital, Tribe Capital, and Nexus Venture Partners
